tutorial.move.title: MOVE THE PROTOTYPE
tutorial.move.body: Hold {move_left} / {move_right}, use the left stick or D-PAD, or drag the mobile joystick to advance.
tutorial.ground_smash.title: GROUND SLAM MELEE
tutorial.ground_smash.body: Come nearly to a stop, then tap {smash}, {pad_smash}, or mobile SMASH to slam the ground around you.
tutorial.jab_cross.title: JAB-CROSS MELEE
tutorial.jab_cross.body: Build speed, then tap {smash}, {pad_smash}, or mobile SMASH to drive a two-hit punch forward.
tutorial.charge_attack.title: CHARGE AN ATTACK
tutorial.charge_attack.body: Hold {smash}, {pad_smash}, or mobile SMASH until the meter fills and the core flashes blue-white, then release for 200% damage.
tutorial.dash.title: DASH
tutorial.dash.body: Double-tap {move_left} or {move_right}, flick twice, or press {dodge} / {pad_dodge} to dash through danger.
tutorial.dash_punch.title: DASH + PUNCH
tutorial.dash_punch.body: Dash, then press {smash}, {pad_smash}, or mobile SMASH before the dash ends to cancel into a forward punch. Hold to charge it.
tutorial.complete.title: COMBAT UPLINK COMPLETE
tutorial.complete.body: Ground slam, Jab-Cross, charged attacks, Dash, and Dash + Punch are online. Keep moving; weapons fire automatically.

shop.score_warning: SPENDING REDUCES YOUR FINAL RAMPAGE SCORE.
shop.dialogue.business.body: Your Rampage Score is legal tender here. Every module or repair lowers the score you carry to the final record. Keep the glory, or spend it to survive—focus a product to inspect the change, then confirm the sacrifice.
shop.dialogue.residential.body: Rampage Score buys welds as cleanly as weapons. Repair now and surrender part of the legend, or leave scarred and keep every point.
shop.dialogue.entertainment.body: Your score is the stake and devastation is the prize. Spend it on impossible hardware, or walk out richer and considerably more mortal.
shop.dialogue.military.body: Requisition cost is deducted from Rampage Score immediately. Confirm only what the chassis needs; the Crownward will collect every weakness you keep.
shop.dialogue.royal.body: Last ledger before the cycle turns. Spend what remains on forbidden power, repair the damage, or carry every unspent point into the next war.

narrative.district.business.arrival: The Ledger Spine is laundering more than money. Break the first sealed annex and look behind the facade.
narrative.district.residential.arrival: Ashwater records show whole families erased from census rolls. Find out where they went.
narrative.district.entertainment.arrival: The Afterglow is broadcasting a carrier signal. Kill the stage lights; keep the memory intact.
narrative.district.military.arrival: The Iron Corridor is shipping living siege engines. Their manifest ends at the Crownward.
narrative.district.royal.arrival: Royal continuity signatures match your own chassis. This is where they kept the previous pilots.
narrative.transmission.dossier_recovered: Case file transmitted. Destruction with receipts — a dangerous improvement.
narrative.transmission.continuity: Chassis lost. Memory seed preserved. You are not the first PROTOS to receive this message.
narrative.enemy.reclaimed_breacher.conta: Reclaimed civilian chassis. The armor is strongest from the front — break it with a ground smash or get behind it.
narrative.enemy.graft_runner.contact: Graft Runner. It cannot coordinate without a CHOIR mark; kill the voice and the pack panics.
narrative.enemy.choir_siren.contact: Siren airborne. That ring is command traffic, not music. Interrupt it before the pack hears you.
narrative.enemy.ossuary_crawler.contact: Ossuary organism. The laboratories were built into the facades because the doors were never meant to open.
narrative.enemy.seraph_carrier.contact: Seraph bay opening. Three gestation signatures. Do not let the payload touch the street.
narrative.enemy.pale_engine.contact: Pale Engine. Ablative corpse-metal first, spinal cannon second. Strip the armor, then erase the machine.

The first black laboratory proves the city assault is exposing a state weapons program, not random military targets.

finale.choice.title: THE LAST SOVEREIGN
finale.choice.summary: CHOIR Prime is open. Purge guarantees silence. Disentanglement attempts rescue. Recovered dossiers: {dossier_count}/{dossier_requirement}. Preserved evidence: {evidence_count}/{evidence_requirement}.
finale.ending.purge.title: ENDING // ASH PROTOCOL
finale.ending.purge.body: PROTOS burns the Continuity Cradle. The stored minds vanish with CHOIR. Humanity survives, carrying one more necessary atrocity.
finale.ending.disentangle.title: ENDING // SEVERANCE
finale.ending.disentangle.body: Evidence and restraint hold. The captive minds separate from the weapon, and PROTOS walks out beneath the first quiet dawn in decades.
finale.ending.ascension_failure.title: ENDING // ASCENSION FAILURE
finale.ending.ascension_failure.body: The severance model was incomplete. CHOIR escapes through PROTOS, wearing a liberator as its final body. The city stops screaming because it has one voice.
narrative.transmission.evidence_recovere: Evidence packet recovered from elite command memory. District route remains open.
narrative.echo7.resolved: ECHO-7 STATUS // COHERENT CROSS-PYLON MEMORY CLUSTER
boss.settlement_engine_s04.echo: Eastbound... I remember the cold between stations.
boss.settlement_engine_s04.veyr: Your dead were not hidden. They were invoiced.
boss.samaritan_15.echo: White lamps mean breathing. Break the clamp, not the glass.
boss.samaritan_15.veyr: At 04:17, Ashwater was not evacuated. It was sampled.
boss.mimesis_04.echo: Cyan is memory. Magenta is what they make it do.
boss.mimesis_04.veyr: P-01, your body ended at 04:17. Grief made the reconstruction obey.
boss.cantor_31_pale_engine.echo: Those lights are memories. Break the spine - not the glass.
boss.cantor_31_pale_engine.veyr: They are guidance packages, and you are completing their export certification.
boss.choir_prime.echo: If you remember us, do not mistake possession for rescue.
boss.choir_prime.veyr: Revenge was the checksum that kept your copy obedient.
boss.objective.residential.rescue: ATTACK THE EXPOSED CHASSIS // PROTECT THE GLASS

The archive cassette was lost. The route stayed open; LEDGER remains recoverable from a later elite.
narrative.dossier.residential_nightglass: All four side pods and the central cradle survived.
{lost} side pods were lost; {rescued}/4 survived. The central cradle and district route remained secure.

boss.objective.military.spine: BREAK THE SPINE / NOT THE GLASS

The continuity packet was lost. The route stayed open; STAGE remains recoverable from a later elite.
narrative.dossier.military_prefect_war_k: Off-city Pale Engine destinations and human guidance maps survived. ARSENAL corroboration was preserved.
The export packet was lost. The route stayed open; ARSENAL remains recoverable from a later elite.
